retrievalProfile.description: A tight, warm-toned facial close-up featuring a smiling subject and distinctive 90s-era swash typography across the top.
triggerTerms: tight facial crop with swash text
warm glow portrait with custom lettering
excludeWhen: minimalist modern sans-serif typography is requested
high-contrast black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact, extreme close-up portrait of a smiling woman, characterized by warm, golden-hour skin tones and a soft-focus finish. The composition is slightly tilted, with the subject's face filling the frame. Across the upper third, a stylized, white, custom-lettered nameplate features dramatic swashes and circular flourishes, typical of late 90s urban music aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: The typography follows the curve of the subject's hairline
Warm skin tones contrast against dark, straight hair framing the face
The bright white of the teeth mirrors the bright white of the typography
A diagonal eye-line creates a sense of dynamic movement within a static frame
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up; the face fills approximately 85% of the frame, slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white smile form a central vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the stylized text at the top, moves down to the eyes, and rests on the smile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the dark hair on the left and right edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and terracotta skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep espresso and black hair tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for typography and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones with soft, low-contrast highlights for a 'glow' effect.

letterConstructionRules: Incorporate large, circular swashes on initial caps
Use sharp, needle-like terminals on horizontal strokes
Vary stroke weight from hairline thin to heavy blocks
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'h' has a descending tail that curves back
Uppercase 'C' is a nearly closed circle with a sharp exit stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone decorative nameplate; no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the specific era-appropriate R&B aesthetic
Provides a similar Art Nouveau-influenced skeleton for modification

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a smiling woman with warm skin tones and dark hair, using soft-focus lighting and a slight diagonal tilt.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay custom white lettering across the top third, featuring dramatic circular swashes and sharp terminals, ensuring it overlaps the hair.

verificationChecks: Is the face the primary focus?
Does the text feature spiral flourishes?
Is the color palette predominantly warm?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the swashes in typography
postGenerationChecks: Check that typography is legible despite swashes
Ensure skin tones are not overly orange
Verify the crop is tight enough to be an 'extreme close-up'
Confirm the white of the text is pure and bright
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up Portrait + Warm Diffused Lighting + Custom 90s Swash Typography Overlay
